title: 8 March 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ fifth lunchtime show at Liverpool’s soon-to-be-famous Cavern Club.

Although the precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

This particular week saw five consecutive lunchtime sessions held at the club. The Beatles performed on Monday, Wednesday and Friday; The Big Three played on Tuesday; and Derry And The Seniors made an appearance on Thursday.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2016: Beatles producer George Martin dies
  • 2015: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Coliseo Yucatán, Mérida, Mexico
  • 1978: Recording: Heart On My Sleeve, Where Did Our Love Go, Tonight, A Man Like Me by Ringo Starr
  • 1977: Recording, mixing: Suicide, London Town, Girls School by Wings
  • 1976: UK single release: Yesterday
  • 1973: Paul McCartney pleads guilty to cannabis cultivation
  • 1973: Recording: Devil Woman, You And Me (Babe) by Ringo Starr
  • 1972: Recording, mixing: New York City by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1972: Recording: The Mess by Wings
  • 1970: Recording: It Don’t Come Easy by Ringo Starr
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Royal Hall, Harrogate
  • 1963: Paul McCartney is fined for speeding
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Storyville Jazz Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Hambleton Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Aintree Institute, Liverpool
  • 1958: The Quarrymen play at Paul McCartney’s cousin’s wedding reception
